gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 04:55:52 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: processBitMaps streams every bit map block through the consumer. Here the filter is empty, but the consumer (a CountingLongPredicate wrapping a predicate whose
ADDED i3: When the consumer rejects the very first bit map block (predicate always returns false), processBitMaps stops immediately and returns false.
ADDED i4: Merging a hasher populates the filter, then processBitMaps is driven by a consumer that rejects a block and returns false. The merge result (true) and the proce
ADDED i5: Merging a hasher and then merging the filter into itself (via BitMapExtractor) both report success.
ADDED i6: Merging an IndexExtractor that contains a negative index is rejected with an IllegalArgumentException ("Value in list -2047 is less than 0").
ADDED i8: Merging an IndexExtractor whose index (31) equals or exceeds the number of bits (max 30) is rejected with an IllegalArgumentException.
ADDED i10: Merging another BloomFilter (here a layered filter whose layers report no indices) into a sparse filter succeeds and returns true.
ADDED i11: After merging a hasher, asBitMapArray returns one long per bit map block; for a shape with 833 bits that is 14 longs.
ADDED i12: clear() empties the filter; characteristics() still reports the SPARSE characteristic (value 1).
ADDED i13: A freshly constructed filter is empty.
ADDED i14: A filter always contains its own bit maps, so contains() returns true.
ADDED i15: estimateIntersection runs without altering the filter's characteristics, which remain SPARSE (value 1).
